features.name: Druid Starting Traits
features.description:
**Primary Ability:** Wisdom
**Hit Point Die:** d8 per Druid level
**Saving Throw Proficiencies:** Intelligence and Wisdom
**Skill Proficiencies:** Choose 2 from Animal Handling, Arcana, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, or Survival
**Weapon Proficiencies:** Simple weapons
**Tool Proficiencies:** Herbalism Kit
**Armor Training:** Light armor and Shields
**Starting Equipment:** Choose A or B: (A) Leather Armor, Shield, Sickle, Druidic Focus (Quarterstaff), Explorer's Pack, Herbalism Kit, and 9 GP; or (B) 50 GP

choices.name: First Skill
choices.description: Choose one from Animal Handling, Arcana, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, or Survival.

choices.name: Second Skill
choices.description: Choose another from the druid skill list.

features.name: Druidic
features.description:
You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids. While learning this ancient tongue, you also unlocked the magic of communicating with animals; you always have the *Speak with Animals* spell prepared.

You can use Druidic to leave hidden messages. You and others who know Druidic automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check but can't decipher it without magic.

features.name: Primal Order
features.description:
You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice.

**Magician.** You know one extra cantrip from the Druid spell list. In addition, your mystical connection to nature gives you a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Nature) checks. The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

**Warden.** Trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor.

choices.name: Primal Order
choices.description: Choose Magician (extra cantrip + WIS bonus to Arcana/Nature) or Warden (martial weapons + medium armor).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
You have learned to cast spells through studying the mystical forces of nature. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability.

**Spell save DC** = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
**Spell attack modifier** = your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier

**Cantrips:** 2 (L1), 3 (L4), 4 (L10). Chosen from the Druid spell list.
**Prepared Spells:** Fixed by class table. Starting at 4 at L1, scaling to 22 at L20. Chosen from the Druid spell list. Changed after each Long Rest.

You can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description:
As a Bonus Action, you shape-shift into a Beast form that you have learned. You stay in that form for a number of hours equal to half your Druid level or until you use Wild Shape again, have the Incapacitated condition, or die.

**Uses:** 2 (L2-5), 3 (L6-16), 4 (L17+). Regain 1 use on Short Rest, all on Long Rest.
**Temporary Hit Points:** When you assume a form, gain Temp HP = your Druid level.
**Known Forms:** 4 (L2), 6 (L4), 8 (L8). Max CR 1/4 (L2), 1/2 (L4), 1 (L8). Fly Speed allowed from L8.

While shape-shifted: your stats are replaced by the beast's (keep INT/WIS/CHA, class features, languages, feats). Can't cast spells but doesn't break Concentration.

payload.name: Wild Shape
payload.description: Transform into a known Beast form. Gain Temp HP = Druid level. Duration: half Druid level in hours.

features.name: Wild Companion
features.description:
You can summon a nature spirit that assumes an animal form to aid you. As a Magic action, you can expend a spell slot or a use of Wild Shape to cast the *Find Familiar* spell without Material components.

When you cast the spell in this way, the familiar is Fey and disappears when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Druid Subclass
features.description: You gain a Druid subclass of your choice. The Circle of the Land subclass is detailed after this class's description.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 4)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Wild Resurgence
features.description:
Once on each of your turns, if you have no uses of Wild Shape left, you can give yourself one use by expending a spell slot (no action required).

In addition, you can expend one use of Wild Shape (no action required) to give yourself a level 1 spell slot, but you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Elemental Fury
features.description:
The might of the elements flows through you. Choose one option:

**Potent Spellcasting.** Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Druid cantrip.

**Primal Strike.** Once per turn when you hit with a weapon or Beast form attack, deal an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (your choice).

choices.name: Elemental Fury
choices.description: Choose Potent Spellcasting (+WIS to cantrip damage) or Primal Strike (+1d8 elemental on weapon/beast hit).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 8)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 12)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Improved Elemental Fury
features.description:
The option you chose for Elemental Fury grows more powerful.

**Potent Spellcasting.** When you cast a Druid cantrip with a range of 10 feet or greater, the spell's range increases by 300 feet.

**Primal Strike.** The extra damage increases to 2d8.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 16)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: While using Wild Shape, you can cast spells in Beast form, except for any spell that has a Material component with a cost specified or that consumes its Material component.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Dimensional Travel is recommended.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description:
The vitality of nature constantly blooms within you, granting you the following benefits.

**Evergreen Wild Shape.** Whenever you roll Initiative and have no uses of Wild Shape left, you regain one expended use of it.

**Nature Magician.** You can convert uses of Wild Shape into a spell slot (no action required). Choose a number of your unexpended uses of Wild Shape and convert them into a single spell slot, with each use contributing 2 spell levels. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

**Longevity.** The primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every ten years that pass, your body ages only one year.
